insurer_name: Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd.
specific_diseases_listed: Cataract, Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy, Hysterectomy for menorrhagia/fibromyoma, Hernia, Hydrocele
Fistula in anus, Piles, Sinusitis and related disorders
Surgery of genitourinary system unless necessitated by malignancy
Surgery of varicose veins and varicose ulcers
Joint Replacement (other than caused by accident)
Surgery of prolapsed inter vertebral disk (other than caused by accident)

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Standard hospitalization cover including room rent, ICU, OT, doctor fees, medicines, diagnostics

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day-care procedures listed by Bajaj Allianz

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Treatment at home for more than 3 days

ayush_coverage.notes: In-patient AYUSH treatment at registered AYUSH hospitals

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Rs 3,000 per hospitalization for road ambulance; air ambulance optional

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Free annual preventive health check-up at network providers; tests vary by SI

maternity_coverage.notes: Optional - covers normal delivery and C-section; waiting period 36 months

newborn_coverage.notes: Newborn baby cover from Day 1 (if maternity opted)

restoration_benefit.notes: Reinstatement of SI once per policy year for unrelated illness

no_claim_bonus_notes: 10% NCB per claim-free year, cap 50% of base SI
room_rent_capping: Single Private AC Room or per Plan; some plans have no room rent cap
icu_capping: Per Plan; typically no cap on premium variants

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Optional worldwide cover available on premium variants

permanent_exclusions: Psychiatric disorders, mental health (subject to IRDAI master circular)
notable_exclusions_summary: Bajaj Allianz Health Guard / Health Care Supreme equivalent. Standard 36-month PED, 24-month specific, 30-day initial waiting. Includes annual preventive check-up, optional maternity, AYUSH.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via 6,500+ network hospitals (pre-auth within 6 hours) or reimbursement (claim documents within 30 days of discharge). Settlement within 30 days of complete documentation.
